mapper.select: select w.id, w.name, w.status, w.created_by, w.updated_by, w.created_at, w.updated_at from workspace w join workspace_member wm on wm.workspace_id = w.id where wm.user_id = #{userId} and wm.status = 'ACTIVE' and w.status = 'ACTIVE' order by w.updated_at desc

select wm.workspace_id, wm.user_id, u.email, u.display_name, wm.role, wm.status, wm.created_by, wm.updated_by, wm.created_at, wm.updated_at from workspace_member wm left join user_account u on u.id = wm.user_id where wm.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} and wm.status = 'ACTIVE' order by wm.role, u.email

select wm.workspace_id, wm.user_id, u.email, u.display_name, wm.role, wm.status, wm.created_by, wm.updated_by, wm.created_at, wm.updated_at from workspace_member wm left join user_account u on u.id = wm.user_id where wm.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} and wm.user_id = #{userId} and wm.status = 'ACTIVE'
